name: contrastapi
description: Security tools for Claude. Most need no API key. They cover CVE/KEV/EPSS, package vulnerabilities, DNS/SSL/email posture, IP and ASN, D3FEND, and CVE and domain monitoring.
long_description: ContrastAPI gives Claude security tools, most with no signup and no API key: CVE intelligence (CVE lookup and search, CISA KEV, EPSS, CVSS, CWE, exploits, risk score and triage, CPE product search), package vulnerabilities (OSV.dev advisories and malicious packages for npm, PyPI, Maven, Go and more, with bulk SBOM checks), domain intelligence (DNS, subdomain takeover, email authentication, email address checks, SSL/TLS, security headers, WHOIS/RDAP, Wayback Machine, Certificate Transparency, subdomains), IP intelligence (IP and ASN lookup), threat defense (MITRE D3FEND defenses for ATT&CK techniques, LOLDrivers vulnerable drivers), breached password checks, service health and the data the server keeps about you, and CVE and domain monitoring through a watchlist. Most tools work out of the box (keyless, 30 credits per hour per IP); an optional Pro key raises limits and is required for the watchlist tools. watchlist_edit changes data: it edits your watchlist. This extension is a thin stdio bridge to the hosted API at api.contrastcyber.com — no data is stored locally.

api_key.title: Pro API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional ContrastAPI Pro key (cc_...) for higher rate limits and the watchlist tools. Leave empty to use the free keyless tier.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Health and Data Freshness — Database freshness: CVE/KEV/CWE counts and latest entries, and the sync state of each upstream feed.

tools.name: cve_lookup
tools.description: CVE Lookup — Full CVE record by ID (CVSS, EPSS, KEV, CWE, references, CISA SSVC, Nuclei detection templates), with the optional GitHub Security Advisory.

tools.name: cve_lookup_bulk
tools.description: Bulk CVE Lookup — Look up many CVEs at once (max 50).

tools.name: cve_products
tools.description: CVE Affected Products — The products a CVE affects, one page at a time, with the vulnerable products first.

tools.name: cve_search
tools.description: CVE Search — Search and filter CVEs with pagination.

tools.name: cve_leading
tools.description: Leading CVEs by EPSS — List the CVEs most likely to be exploited, by EPSS score: the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days.

tools.name: kev_lookup
tools.description: CISA KEV Lookup — CISA KEV catalog entry for a CVE.

tools.name: cwe_lookup
tools.description: CWE Lookup — CWE weakness details (description, mitigations, examples).

tools.name: cve_risk_score
tools.description: CVE Risk Score — Composite risk score of a CVE (exploitability + impact + evidence), from 0 to 100, for patch priority.

tools.name: cve_exploit
tools.description: CVE Exploit Intelligence — Public exploit intelligence (GitHub PoCs, Metasploit, NVD exploit references, ExploitDB).

tools.name: cve_triage
tools.description: CVE Triage — Minimal CVE prioritisation list: asset scope (vendor/product) + a min_risk_score threshold, always ordered by composite risk score.

tools.name: cve_triage_bulk
tools.description: Bulk CVE Triage — Triage many CVEs at once (max 50), ranked by composite risk score.

tools.name: product_exposure
tools.description: Product Exposure — Aggregate CVE exposure for one vendor+product: severity/KEV/PoC counts, max/avg CVSS, max EPSS, worst composite risk score, plus the top CVEs by risk.

tools.name: cpe_search
tools.description: CPE Search — Find the CPE vendor and product names that hold a text, ranked by vulnerable CVE count.

tools.name: cvss_calculator
tools.description: CVSS Calculator — Decode a CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector into its base metrics and recompute its base, temporal and environmental scores.

tools.name: watchlist_edit
tools.description: Watchlist: CVE and Domain Monitoring — Add, remove, list or clear the items of this API key's watchlist, for CVE and domain monitoring.

tools.name: watchlist_events
tools.description: Monitoring Events — Read the monitoring events of this API key's watchlist: the CVE and domain changes that match it, oldest first.

tools.name: privacy_my_data
tools.description: Privacy: My Data — What this server keeps about the caller: the hash its credits are counted under, the rate limit left in this hour, and each kind of record it keeps.

tools.name: password_check
tools.description: Breached Password Check — Check a password's SHA-1 against Have I Been Pwned's Pwned Passwords list.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS Lookup — Look up a domain's DNS records: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT (such as SPF and verification records), CNAME, SOA and CAA.

tools.name: dns_takeover_check
tools.description: Subdomain Takeover Check — Check a host name for subdomain takeover through a dangling CNAME: a CNAME that points to a name that does not exist.

tools.name: email_auth_check
tools.description: Email Authentication Check (SPF, DMARC, DKIM) — Check a domain's mail authentication: its SPF record, the DMARC record that applies to it, its DKIM keys, its MX hosts and its MTA-STS record.

tools.name: email_address_check
tools.description: Email Address Check — Check an e-mail address without sending mail: whether its domain exists and takes mail, through its MX hosts or, with no MX record, its own address; a null MX takes none.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: SSL/TLS Certificate Check — Check the TLS certificate and the TLS settings of a host name on port 443.

tools.name: headers_check
tools.description: Security Headers Check — Check the security headers of a web site.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: WHOIS / RDAP Lookup — Look up the registration of a domain name: its registrar and IANA Registrar ID, when it was registered, last changed and expires, its status values, its name servers and whether its delegation is signed with DNSSEC.

tools.name: wayback_lookup
tools.description: Wayback Machine Lookup — List when the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine captured the home page of a host name: the first and the last capture day, the years between them, and the latest 10 capture days, each with the HTTP status and the media type of the captured answer and a link to the capture.

tools.name: cert_search
tools.description: Certificate Transparency Search — List the unexpired certificates that Certificate Transparency logs hold for a host name, wildcard certificates that match it included, as SSLMate's Cert Spotter finds them.

tools.name: subdomain_enum
tools.description: Subdomain Enumeration — List the subdomains of a registrable domain from three sources: Certificate Transparency, as SSLMate's Cert Spotter gives it in the first page of its answer; DNS A queries for 94 common names; and the names the domain's own MX, NS and SPF records give.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: IP Lookup — Look up a public IPv4 or IPv6 address: its AS number, AS name and AS country, its country, the cloud provider and service whose published range holds it, whether it is a CDN, a datacenter or a Tor exit, the DROP prefixes that list it, and its PTR name.

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: ASN Lookup — Look up an autonomous system (AS) by its number, such as AS15169, or by a public IPv4 or IPv6 address it holds: its AS number, name and registration country, the prefix that holds the address, how many IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes it has, and one page of up to 50 prefixes of each family in address order.

tools.name: d3fend_for_attack
tools.description: D3FEND Defenses for ATT&CK — MITRE D3FEND defenses that counter a MITRE ATT&CK technique.

tools.name: driver_lookup
tools.description: Vulnerable Driver Lookup (LOLDrivers) — Look up a Windows driver file in the LOLDrivers catalog of vulnerable and malicious drivers.

tools.name: driver_lookup_bulk
tools.description: Bulk Driver Lookup — Look up many driver file hashes in the LOLDrivers catalog at once (max 25).

tools.name: package_check
tools.description: Package Vulnerability Check — Check a package of npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io, Packagist or SwiftURL against the OSV.dev advisories of GitHub, Go, PyPA and RustSec, and the OpenSSF list of malicious packages.

tools.name: package_check_bulk
tools.description: Bulk Package Check (SBOM) — Check many packages at once (max 500) against the advisories package_check reads.
